hook.name: Grate
hook.description: A fee hook for the Drainpad token launchpad that charges a fixed 4% fee on all swaps, using BeforeSwapDelta for exact-input and AfterSwapDelta for exact-output. Fee proceeds are split 75% to the pool's registered creator and 25% to a treasury, banked as ERC-6909 claims and redeemable via a separate withdraw call. Only pools registered by the Drainpad launchpad contract may use this hook.
